notes.title: The Second Score Contest is Here to Celebrate the Degica Weekend Sale!
notes.content:
The Degica Weekend Sale is here and that means it's time for the second Judgement Silversword score contest! 

But first, check out the sale. JSS is 40% off and there are discounts on our other SHMUPS as well (like Eschatos).
http://store.steampowered.com/sale/degica/

 The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/278510/announcements/detail/601619456913517687]first[/url] Judgement Silversword score contest, "Paradiso", was a success! Our thanks to all who participated!

Paradiso winners are in green boxes. Purgatorio winners are in yellow...
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168103/129f2cd5677a17d3beeed7a0b1fad6bd8160e14b.png[/img]

[h1]Contest One "Paradiso" is Complete!:[/h1]
[b]This contest is over.[/b] Contestants competed in a score contest in Cardinal Sins’s Normal Mode. 

[h1]Contest Two “Inferno”:[/h1]
Begins immediately and runs until October 27th at 9AM PT. 

Contestants will compete in a score contest in Judgement Silversword’s [b]Hard difficulty[/b]. This is the main mode of the game, not Cardinal Sins. Scores submitted in normal difficulty will not be counted. The top three scores at the time of contest completion will be the winners. Scores submitted before or after the contest will not be counted. 

[h1]Contest Gaiden “Purgatorio”:[/h1]
The first Purgatorio contest is complete, but we're holding a second! 

Anyone who submits a score during the Inferno contest (and isn’t in the top three) will be eligible for the Purgatorio contest. Ten random eligible scores will be selected. The top three highest scores of those ten random selections will be our Purgatorio winners. This essentially creates a contest between ten random contestants, regardless of skill level, so make sure you submit your best score, even if you're not near the top three scores on the board! 

Prizes:
All winners can pick one of the following: a Steam key for ESCHATOS or JSS, a Steam key for the ESCHATOS AST or OST, or $5 USD in Steam wallet credit. 

...Good luck, everyone! Need some tips and info on the game? Check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=776016437]this[/url] guide and (Unofficial) Manual written by yours truly!

[h1] Giveaway![/h1]
In addition, we're running a giveaway this weekend with [b]$1000 in Steam Wallet Codes[/b] up for grabs! You can get all of details and enter here: http://promo.degicagames.com/weekend-deal-giveaway/

notes.title: Online Leaderboards Now Available With Score Contests!
notes.content:

Begins immediately and runs until October 13th at 6PM PT.

Contestants will compete in a score contest in Cardinal Sins’s Normal Mode. The top three scores at the time of contest completion will be the winners. Scores submitted before or after the contest will not be counted.

[h1]Contest Two “Inferno”:[/h1]
Details to be announced! Mu-wa-HA-HAAA!

Anyone who submits a score during either contest (and isn’t in the top three) will be eligible for the Purgatorio contest. Ten random eligible scores will be selected. The top three highest scores of those ten random selections will be our Purgatorio winners. This essentially creates a contest between ten random contestants, regardless of skill level, so make sure you submit your best score, even if you're not near the top three scores on the board!

[h1]Prizes:[/h1]
All winners can pick one of the following: a Steam key for ESCHATOS or JSS, a Steam key for the ESCHATOS AST or OST, or $5 USD in Steam wallet credit.

...Good luck, everyone!
